description: Shows one exercise group with its exercises, rounds, breaks and per-exercise work setting. Use when the user wants to see what is inside a circuit or sets group before using or changing it. Not for changing it (use update_exercise_group). Returns the group's settings and its exercises in order, with IDs.

id.description: ID of the exercise group. Get it from list_exercise_groups.

name: get_exercise_group
title: Get exercise group
